summary:
**Automated review — PR #XXXX**

Summary of findings. Replace with the real review. Non-blocking items marked 🔵/🟡.

findings.title: Unbounded query / N+1
findings.body: This loops over `$orders` and lazy-loads `->machine` each iteration → N+1. Eager load with `->with('machine')` and paginate; unbounded `all()` will not scale.

findings.title: OData used for new endpoint
findings.body: New data fetched via OData. Project rule: custom REST only via `CommonService` with `isLodata=false`. Move this to a `routes/api.php` endpoint + API Resource.

findings.title: Missing index + magic default
findings.body: `status` is filtered in WHERE but not indexed — add `$table->index('status')`. Also the default `'ACTIVE'` is a magic string; reference `OrderStatusEnum::ACTIVE->value`.
